problem: Turn the validated movement-through pollination verb into a complete production loop where actual travel inside a patch advances readable progress, standing still adds no work, one incidental straight pass cannot complete the first patch, completion awards Honey exactly once, unlocks dependent content and survives reload on desktop and touch.

decision.rationale: Retain D-006 movement ownership and productionize it with work targets above each forgiving-zone diameter. Exact-head browser evidence shows zero stationary work, ~82-83% progress from one straight first-patch fly-through, completion on a return sweep, one Honey transaction/audio hook, durable unlock/reload, two-cluster HUD density and readable redundant locked-state text after two visual iterations.

selected_references.name: Cow Bay object interaction
selected_references.selection_reason: A shipped browser/mobile gathering loop makes resource intent explicit through object actions, providing a direct action-count contrast.
selected_references.observed_behavior: Poki documents tapping/clicking objects to use or harvest them.
selected_references.inference: BeBee can preserve lower input cost only if movement-owned activation and completion feedback remain visually unambiguous.

selected_references.name: Dreamdale proximity harvesting
selected_references.selection_reason: A materially different low-input harvesting model highlights the risk that proximity alone rewards waiting rather than traversal.
selected_references.observed_behavior: The mechanics reference describes resources that can be harvested while standing near them or walking over them without repeated tapping.
selected_references.inference: BeBee should preserve low input cost but require measured movement distance, with stationary work explicitly tested at zero.

anti_pattern.observation: Forager combines movement with repeated explicit hit/tool actions for resource collection.
anti_pattern.lesson: Do not add a permanent repeated pollination action to BeBee unless later comprehension evidence shows movement ownership is insufficient.

official_docs.verified_constraint: Runtime GUI nodes can be created and mutated from GUI scripts; P2 keeps flower/HUD rendering presentation-only and domain ownership outside GUI.
P2 uses supported GUI node size/color/enabled/text mutation APIs and maps a font before selecting it for runtime text.
Persistent writes belong behind the existing storage abstraction; P2 does not call sys.save directly from FlowerPatch/economy gameplay and retains the existing size/error lifecycle protections.

alternatives.reason: Allows stationary progress and makes stopping potentially optimal, contradicting direct BB-P003/P2 evidence.
A single ideal straight pass could finish an untouched patch, making completion too incidental.
Keeps progress owned by actual movement, gives immediate partial progress, prevents a single straight center pass from completion and needs no second pollination control.
P2 requires durable completion/Honey; saving high-frequency partial work would add write/lifecycle complexity without a milestone need.
